text:
olivia: Posted a quick mock for the alerting preview in the SLO editor — screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/alerts/preview-v3.png. Need input on three items: 1) Should suppression state be shown as a concise pill or full sentence? 2) Channel list: inline +N expand vs always stacked? 3) How to surface fallback routing without clutter?

ben: My 2¢: concise pill by default, full sentence in tooltip or expandable row. For channels show up to 2 chips then a "+N" button that expands into a stacked list preserving order. Keeps the panel tidy.

sam: Accessibility note: if we hide the full text visually, ensure an offscreen element exposes it to SRs. The +N must be keyboard-focusable and announce "expand channels". Also suppression changes should fire `aria-live` to notify screen readers when state flips.

priya: Contrast nit: current suppression pill uses pale yellow that fails AA on white. Recommend a slightly darker token or a 1px neutral border. Also ensure focus ring on chips meets 3:1 at minimum for visibility.

ben: Microcopy debate: options for the pill - A) "Suppressed · schedule" B) "Muted until 15:00" C) "Silenced by on-call rota"; my pick A for compactness, but B is clearer for timelines.

sam: Lean B for clarity when duration matters. If we use A as default, show full time in tooltip and include timestamp in offscreen SR text. Example aria-label: "Suppressed until 2026-06-10 15:00 by schedule".

olivia: Good point. Proposal: default to concise `Muted · schedule` (friendly), hover/expand reveals full reason and end time, and SR gets full sentence. For routing, show `fallback: regional` as muted inline text under channels; if there's a canary show `canary → us-west` prepended.

priya: Small implementation detail: avoid `→` for screen readers, prefer `to` in aria text (visual can keep arrow). Also check color tokens on figma frame. design-bot: figma update https://www.figma.com/file/abc/alert-preview-v3

ben: I'll prototype the +N expansion interaction and keyboard flow. @sam can you draft the aria pattern for badges and expansions?

sam: Yep — I'll add a short spec: `role=button` for +N, `aria-expanded` toggles, offscreen `div` with `aria-live="polite"` for suppression updates, badges `role=status` with full `aria-label`.

olivia: Action list: @ben prototype +N expansion, @sam write aria spec, @priya post contrast tokens and alt color. Sync Wednesday 4pm to review. :calendar:
